I’m Irene Diamond. In 1995, I opened San Francisco’s very first wellness center, Diamond Pain Relief & Wellness. Today, as Clinical Director, I work with just a handful of clients each month, specializing in migraine, fibromyalgia, and orthopedic rehab.

I created Active Modulation Therapy® and Diamond Active Massage™️—The Diamond Method®, unique “inside-out” approaches where clients actively move during treatment with therapeutic exercises for superior progress. These methods deliver faster pain and stress relief, easier movement, and lasting guaranteed results.

I’m also a best-selling author and consultant. Health and wellness practitioners worldwide—massage therapists, physical therapists, chiropractors, acupuncturists, and luxury spas—turn to me to maximize revenue, delight clients, and prevent burnout. I also provide corporate wellness training for companies ready to elevate employees' health.

👉 Subscribe, comment, and click links: 
Together, we’re even more brilliant.
~ Irene
